title: A variational approach for the 2D Abelian Yang-Mills-Higgs measure
summary: We use the Boué-Dupuis variational method to construct the Abelian Yang-Mills-Higgs measure on the two-dimensional torus with polynomial Higgs potentials, giving, to our knowledge, the first rigorous construction of an interacting gauge theory by this approach. We first use the variational method to construct the Higgs field conditioned on the gauge field, with a covariant Gaussian free field as the reference measure.
